documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive reported 52.1% year-on-year consolidated revenue growth in Q1 FY27, achieving its highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management revised its full-year revenue growth guidance upward from mid-teens to high-teens due to strong order inflow and industry momentum. To accommodate new customer orders, the company plans to set up a new plant in Bangalore, raising its FY27 capex guidance to approximately Rs. 700 crore. Management expects EBITDA margins to settle between 13.5% and 14% as aluminum prices cool off.

guidance.claim: Management has revised its full-year revenue growth guidance to high-teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: The company expects a 20% increase in export revenues for the year.
guidance.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company is confident that it will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

guidance.claim: The management expects revenue of around Rs. 90 to Rs. 100 Cr for the alloy wheel business in FY27.
guidance.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

demand_outlook.claim: The two-wheeler industry recorded 22.8% year-on-year production growth in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler segment, which is most relevant to us, recorded production growth of 22.8% on a year-on-year basis, with total two-wheeler production of 72.5 lakh units in Q1 FY27, up from 59.50 lakh units in the same quarter last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Easing monsoon deficits support rural income and two-wheeler demand outlook ahead of the festive season.
demand_outlook.quote: The monsoon deficit witnessed earlier in the season has eased on the back of rainfall in late June and early July, supporting the outlook for rural income and two-wheeler demand in the run-up to the festive season.

demand_outlook.claim: Consolidated revenue growth for Q1 FY27 outperformed industry growth.
The company commenced supply of high pressure die casted alloy wheels to its leading Japanese customer.
demand_outlook.quote: 1st Supply of High Pressure Die Casted Alloy Wheel has started to our leading Japanese customer.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic that the growth momentum will remain in the coming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite these challenges, we are optimistic that the growth momentum will remain in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: The independent aftermarket business grew by 24.7% in FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Happy to share that our independent aftermarket has grown by 24.7% in FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM customers are carrying on with their original production schedules showing nice growth.
demand_outlook.quote: As far outlook of the two-wheeler industry is concerned, our all our OEM customers they are carrying on with their original production schedules which shows a nice growth in this year also and none of the supplies have been affected by the raw materials or anything.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's second captive solar plant of 11.55 MW at Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: ASK Automotive is urgently setting up a new plant in Bangalore to cater to new orders.
capex_expansion.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Full-year capex guidance has been raised from Rs. 450-500 crore to around Rs. 700 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: We had given guidance about around Rs. 450 crore to Rs. 500 crore, but the way we are going and receiving the orders, as I today revised the guidance to high-teens, I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan was successfully implemented at the Karoli plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Happy to share that the technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been successfully implemented at our Karoli plant and 1st Supply of High Pressure Die Casted Alloy Wheel has started to our leading Japanese customer.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

margins_costs.claim: ASK Automotive recorded Q1 EBITDA of Rs. 164 crore with an EBITDA margin of 12%.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 164 crore with 32.7% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin stood at 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Management anticipates an improvement in EBITDA margins as aluminum prices remain benign.
margins_costs.quote: However, with aluminum prices expected to remain benign in the coming quarters, we anticipate an improvement in our EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects overall EBITDA margins to remain in the range of 13.5% to 14%.
margins_costs.quote: The overall margins you will be finding at around 13.5% to 14% in between that.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for Q4 FY26 reached Rs. 140 Cr with a margin of 12.1%.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 140 Cr with 31.1% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 12.1%, however, this EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices as mentioned earlier.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA stood at Rs. 551 Cr with a margin of 13.1%.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 551 Cr with 24.1% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 13.1%, however, EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices.

margins_costs.claim: Management aims to sustain the current level of EBITDA margins and gradually improve them.
margins_costs.quote: Our aim is to sustain current level of EBITDA margins and continue our efforts to improve gradually in the subsequent quarters, depending upon the growth of the two-wheeler industry and geopolitical environment.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has confirmed alloy wheel orders of Rs. 70-90 crore for FY27 and Rs. 250 crore for FY28.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Export revenue from the Ford Motors order is expected to be Rs. 40-45 crore this year and Rs. 60 crore next year.
orders_capacity.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant improved to about 75% in the current quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Bangalore plant, which was our 18th plant, is running at near optimum capacity utilization and happy to share that against the installed capacity in Karoli plant, from 60% to 65% that we were in the last quarter, we have now gone up to about 75%

orders_capacity.claim: A 9.9 MWp solar power plant for captive consumption was operationalized.
orders_capacity.quote: 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption operationalized.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Bengaluru plant has reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant is currently at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's philosophy is to plow back internal accruals into business operations.
capital_allocation.quote: The philosophy of the company is to completely plow back the internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Management expects debt-to-equity ratio to remain below 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to take term loans to fund machinery acquisitions.
capital_allocation.quote: We will be taking term loan for machines.

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a strategic closure of its low value-added wheel assembly business.
capital_allocation.quote: Strategic Closure of low value-added Wheel Assembly business

capital_allocation.claim: Wheel assembly sales became nil with effect from April 1, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: With effect from 01.04.2026, WA Sales are Nil

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals and free cash will be ploughed back into the company while containing debt levels.
capital_allocation.quote: All these internal accruals free cash will be ploughed back in the company, so we will see to it even the debt levels are contained within the limits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia led to volatility in commodity markets and higher aluminum alloy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Alloy price volatility can affect EBITDA margin percentages due to the denominator effect.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts in West Asia have disrupted the global economy and affected supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export revenue declined in FY26 due to various international trade disruptions and bottlenecks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost pressures have arisen due to recent developments in geopolitics and minimum wage hikes.
risks_headwinds.quote: Recent developments in geopolitical scenario and significant increase in minimum wages by some of the state governments has created an input cost pressure on the industry.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets high-teens revenue growth for the full financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 MW at Bikaner will be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to operationalize its new Bangalore plant before March in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve a 20% growth in export sales this year.
management_commitments.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects its second captive solar plant in Bikaner to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve mid-teens revenue growth in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to invest approximately Rs. 400 Cr in capex during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
